programme.desc: Uncover the hidden treasures of Montenegro, where rugged mountains meet the sparkling Adriatic. From the mediaeval charm of Kotor to serene bays and vibrant seaside villages, Montenegro offers a striking mix of natural beauty, rich history, and authentic Mediterranean culture.

programme.title: Med Destinations Ancona
programme.desc: Explore Ancona, a bustling port city on the Adriatic, with Med Destinations. Discover its historic landmarks, scenic waterfronts, and the unique blend of maritime tradition and modern Italian life.

programme.title: Med Destinations Malta
programme.desc: Med Destinations uncovers the magic of Malta, an island rich in history, culture, and stunning coastal landscapes. From medieval streets to turquoise waters, Malta is a Mediterranean treasure.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine
programme.desc: The flavors of land and sea are brought together in the kitchen, with prawn linguine, a light and savory pasta dish brimming with fresh Mediterranean seafood. For dessert, galaktompoureko, a traditional Greek custard-filled pastry with golden, crispy layers, provides a sweet and indulgent finale. An episode celebrating the best of classic Mediterranean cuisine.

programme.title: Med Destinations Crete
programme.desc: Med Destinations takes you to Crete, the jewel of the Greek islands, where ancient history meets breathtaking landscapes. Explore charming villages, hidden beaches, and the vibrant local culture that makes Crete a must-visit Mediterranean paradise.

programme.title: Med Institutions
programme.desc: Join Vanessa McDonald as she speaks to the outgoing Secretary General of the Union for the Mediterranean about culture, connection and what brings the Mediterranean together. They look back at some of the highlights of his time in the role and what comes next, from exciting initiatives and cultural partnerships to breaking stereotypes and building stronger connections between countries. It’s a conversation about big ideas, shared experiences and why, despite our differences, the Mediterranean has more in common than we might think.

programme.title: Jesenice
programme.desc: In the hillside village of Staro Selo Jesenice, with views of the central Dalmatian islands, we found stone houses, a bocce court, and a traditional tavern run by Ante Bajso. There, he treated us to a Dalmatian classic—meat slow-cooked under a bell-shaped lid, peka.

programme.title: MED Destination VENICE
programme.desc: WITH VO

programme.title: Secret Garden Villa
programme.desc: Annette shows off a lovely detached house in the lovely village of Vigneta, which is only 20 minutes by car from Fivizzano. The upstairs is almost ready for people to move in right away, and the basement is a great place to do some renovations. Outside, you'll also find a beautiful, large garden that perfectly captures the spirit of Italian village life.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: For many travelers, the quintessence of Spain is found in Andalucía. Join us in Granada, Córdoba, and the Costa del Sol as we enjoy the food, history, art, and dance of Europe's most passionate corner.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Palermo
programme.desc: Malini Angelica returns to Sicily to explore Palermo, Mondello, and Agrigento. From Palermo’s vibrant markets and rich history to Mondello’s seaside charm and the ancient Greek temples of Agrigento, she uncovers the island’s unique mix of cultures, cuisine, and character that make Sicily truly one of a kind.

programme.title: Colours of Mediterranean Culture
programme.desc: From Malta to Greece, Mediterranean arts flourish. Valletta Baroque Festival, Malta International Arts Festival, and Birgu by Candlelight light up the island with music and heritage. Italy’s Cortona on the Move, La Fenice in Piazza San Marco, and Mercantia Festival showcase photography, opera, and street performance. France’s Art Paris and International Garden Festival, Spain’s Revela’t Festival and La Leyenda de Tartessos, Portugal’s Umbrella Sky Project and Walk And Talk Biennale, Turkey’s Istanbul Theatre Festival and Biennial, and Greece’s Athens And Epidaurus Festival highlight the Med’s rich artistic tapestry.

programme.title: Made in Med: Craft of Leatherworking
programme.desc: An adventurer in search of meaning, Keith's joumey from former army captain to craftsman is anything but ordinary. While stationed in Livorno, Italy, his experiences exploring the country and the beauty of Florence sparked a lasting fascination with leatherworking. Now, Fadi steps into Keith's workshop in Rabat to explore how that experience inspired a new chapter in his life, discovering the skill, creativity, and dedication behind his craft.

programme.title: Dates that made history
programme.desc: Mansa Musa's Pilgrimage to Mecca explores the extraordinary journey of Mansa Musa, the emperor of Mali, to Mecca in 1324. Highlighting the wealth and power of the Mali Empire as Musa’s caravan traverses the Sahara, spreading wealth and religious influence. It examines the impact of his pilgrimage on both the Islamic world and Africa’s place in global history. Through this journey, Mansa Musa’s legacy of generosity and cultural exchange becomes legendary.

programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who get it. Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Progressive Metal Laboratory
programme.desc: A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths

programme.desc: SonUva Digger’s Ryan Anderson attempts to win back-to-back event championships while closing the gap in his quest for a third straight series title. programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: The Huntington Center in Toledo ignites with Ohio Octane as Round 11 of the Freestyle Mania Championship Series gets underway. In a high-stakes showdown that blends the raw power of Monster Jam with elite freestyle motocross, eight top-tier teams battle for supremacy on a track described as sticky like bubble gum. Watch as Weston Anderson in Grave Digger attempts to set a blistering pace against fierce competition from Fernando Martinez in El Toro Loco and hometown hero Chuckie Pauken. From the high-speed precision of JCB Racing to the gravity-defying maneuvers of the Two-Wheel Skills Challenge, every moment is a quest for the critical points needed to crown the night's overall champion.

programme.title: More Than a Friend
programme.desc: Simeon struggles in his romantic relationships due to his close friendship with his so-called business partner, Amanda.

programme.title: Demands
programme.desc: The lives of two couples is forever entwined as they deal with lack of commitment, infidelity and unexpected pregnancies.

The problem is, he doesn't know who the culprit is amongst all the women he has angered.

programme.desc: Respect was optional. Victory was everything. Relive the rivalries that defined eras and the battles where legacies were forged inside the cage.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 2
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Juha (Sakari Kuosmanen, Kauas pilvet karkaavat) ja Marja (Kati Outinen, Sauna) elävät yhdessä onnellisina ja viattomina kuin lapset kunnes käärme luikertelee paratiisiin Shemeikan (André Wilms, Boheemielämää) hahmossa. Juha perustuu Juhani Ahon kuuluisaan romaaniin.

programme.title: Hamlet liikemaailmassa
programme.desc: Maailmankirjallisuuden tunnetuin sukudraama on siiretty nykysuomen liike-elämän vallan linnakkeisiin, keskelle Helsingin rock´n rollin tahdissa sykkivää betoniviidakkoa.

programme.title: Helsinki-Napoli All Night Long
programme.desc: Suomalainen Alex ajaa taksia Berliinin kolkoilla kaduilla. Ilta vaikuttaa alkavan kuten mikä tahansa muukin, vaimon heittäminen töihin, Igorin kanssa asioiden hoitelua, mutta sitten kyytiin hyppää kaksi hämärämiestä suuren rahalaukun kanssa, takaa-ajajat kintereillään!

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: Münsterin juttu
programme.desc: Varakas viininmaahantuoja löydetään brutaalisti murhattuna voimakkaan iskun jälkeen päähän. Münster saa tapauksen tutkittavakseen.

programme.title: I Hired a Contract Killer
programme.desc: Henri Boulanger (Jean-Pierre Léaud) seisoo vähäpätöisen virkansa menetettyään keskellä Lontoon miljoonakaupunkia ja huomaa, ettei hänellä ole ainoatakaan ystävää eikä sukulaista.

programme.title: Tulitikkutehtaan tyttö
programme.desc: Äitinsä ja isäpuolensa kanssa asuva ja tulitikkutehtaan liukuhihnalla työskentelevä Iiris (Kati Outinen, Mies vailla menneisyyttä ja Le Havre) erehtyy luulemaan tanssiravintolassa kohtaamansa miehen kanssa viettämäänsä yötä rakkaudeksi. Väärinkäsityksellä on kohtalokkaat seuraukset.

programme.title: JP ja Murtovaras
programme.desc: Sallikkalan kuntaa piinaa sarja murtovarkauksia, ja luvattomalle yöseikkailulle lähtenyt lapsikolmikko luulee nähneensä varkaan itse teossa! Nyt on perustettava salapoliisitoimisto ja ratkaistava juttu!

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Juha (Sakari Kuosmanen, Kauas pilvet karkaavat) ja Marja (Kati Outinen, Sauna) elävät yhdessä onnellisina ja viattomina kuin lapset kunnes käärme luikertelee paratiisiin Shemeikan (André Wilms, Boheemielämää) hahmossa. Juha perustuu Juhani Ahon kuuluisaan romaaniin.

programme.title: Winnerbäck
programme.desc: Lars Winnerbäck on lukeutunut Ruotsin suurimpiin artisteihin jo 15 vuotta, ja kuitenkin hän on se, josta tiedetään vähiten. Nyt tuskin 40 täyttänyt Winnerbäck viettää 20. taiteilijavuottaan.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Calamari Union
programme.desc: Calamari Union on kaikkien aikojen kulttiklassikko, joka kertoo seitsemäntoista Frankin ja yhden Pekan matkasta Kallion varjoisilta kujilta kohti Eiran raikkaita tuulia, joista he ovat kuulleet isovanhempiensa kertovan.

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 2
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Lindell - Hunajasyötti - Osa 1
programme.desc: On kesä. Elena Bukotaite - jäätelötehtaalla työskentelevä liettualaisnainen - ajetaan autolla kuoliaaksi. Samaan aikaan poliisi etsii 8-vuotiasta Høvikissä kadonnutta poikaa. Wiggo Nyman ajaa jäätelöautoa alueella. Hän oli myös Elenan miesystävä. Liittyvätkö tapaukset toisiinsa?

programme.title: Lindell - Hunajasyötti - Osa 2
programme.desc: On kesä. Elena Bukotaite - jäätelötehtaalla työskentelevä liettualaisnainen - ajetaan autolla kuoliaaksi. Samaan aikaan poliisi etsii 8-vuotiasta Høvikissä kadonnutta poikaa. Wiggo Nyman ajaa jäätelöautoa alueella. Hän oli myös Elenan miesystävä. Liittyvätkö tapaukset toisiinsa?

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Hella W
programme.desc: Sankarittaren elämä. Hella Wuolijoen elämä ja työ. Runoilija, vakooja ja miljonääri, josta tuli kansainvälisesti tunnettu liikenainen, poliitikko ja näytelmäkirjailija, joka teki yhteistyötä Euroopan johtavien kirjailijoiden, kuten Bertolt Brechtin ja Maksim Gorkin.

programme.title: Beyond Dreams
programme.desc: Mirja (Evin Ahmad) etsii paikkaansa maailmassa vankilasta päästyään. Saatuaan töitä hotellisiivoojana hän alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Hänen sairas äitinsä ja vanhat ystävänsä, jotka ovat olleet hänen oikea perheensä, repivät häntä kahtaalle.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana
programme.desc: Koskenkorvaa litkivä automekaanikko Reino (Matti Pellonpää) ja kahvista riippuvainen peräkamarin poika Valto (Mato Valtonen) lähtevät viettämään viikonloppua ja kohtaavat matkalla virolaisen Tatjanan (Kati Outinen) ja venäläisen Klavdian (Kirsi Tykkyläinen).

programme.title: Van Veeteren - Carambole
programme.desc: Mies törmää autollaan 14-vuotiaaseen poikaan, joka saa surmansa välittömästi. Tapahtuma-aikana on pimeää ja sateista, ja mies pakenee onnettomuuspaikalta. Tämä on virhe, jota hän tulee katumaan katkerasti, ja joka muuttaa hänen koko elämänsä.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 1
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: The Quiet Roar
programme.desc: Marianne (Evabritt Strandberg) on 68-vuotias nainen, jolla on parantumaton sairaus. Ahdistuneena hän hakeutuu terapiaan klinikalle, jossa häntä hoidetaan psilosybiinilla (LSD:llä) ja hoitaja Eva (Hanna Schygulla) johdattaa hänet meditaatioon.

programme.title: Boheemielämää
programme.desc: Boheemielämää kertoo kolmen taiteilijan tarinan. Kirjailija Marcel Marxin, taidemaalari Rodolfon ja säveltäjä Shaunardin, rakkauksien, töiden ja ainaisen rahapulan värittämään taiteilijaelämään pureutuva elokuva perustuu Henri Murgerin kuuluisaan samannimiseen romaaniin vuodelta 1851.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Zombie ja kummitusjuna
programme.desc: Zombie on oman tiensä kulkija, joka ei pysty noudattamaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan hänelle asettamia normeja. Zombie päättää jättää kaiken ja suunnata ulkomaille - paikkaan jossa kukaan ei odota häneltä mitään. Zombie ja kummitusjuna kuuluu monien mielestä Mika Kaurismäen elokuvien parhaimmistoon.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Jimmy Jones
programme.desc: Hyväsydäminen pikkurikollinen Jimmy Jones Malmöstä yrittää tienata rutkasti rahaa. Hän toimii välikätenä huumekaupassa, jota käyvät hollantilainen huumesyndikaatti ja Tukholmassa oleskeleva serbialainen pokerinpelaaja Dragan.

programme.title: Van Veeteren - Tapaus G
programme.desc: Van Veeterenin ainoa selvittämättömäksi jäänyt tapaus näkee jälleen päivänvalon kun erään yksityisetsivän tytär tulee tapaamaan häntä. Väkivaltainen murhaaja, joka katosi vuosia sitten jäljettömiin, vaikuttaa palanneen uudella nimellä varustettuna - ja sekaantuneena uuteen murhaan.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: White People
programme.desc: Alex (Vera Vitali) siepataan kadulla ruokakaupan edessä ja hänet viedään maanalaisiin tiloihin, joissa ihmiset odottavat vangittuina karkotustaan. Viktoria (Pernilla August, “Tähtien Sota: Episodi I – Pimeä uhka”) on operaation pomo, joka hallitsee miehistöään rautaisin ottein.

programme.title: Historiaa Tehdään Öisin
programme.desc: Harry on CIA-agentti, joka toimii peitetehtävissä helsinkiläisen Moving Planet -jazzklubin omistajana. Nuori SVR-agentti Natasha asuu myös Helsingissä – hänen tehtävänä on vakoilla Harrya.

programme.title: The Lady In The Bottle
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: My Hero?
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Marriage Caper
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: G.I. Jeannie
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: The Yacht Murder Case
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: Anybody Here Seen Jeannie?
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: The Americanization Of Jeannie
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book How To Be A Woman. Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Curious Kid

programme.title: The Lady In The Bottle
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: My Hero?
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Marriage Caper
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: G.I. Jeannie
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: The Yacht Murder Case
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: Anybody Here Seen Jeannie?
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: The Americanization Of Jeannie
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book How To Be A Woman. Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Curious Kid
programme.desc: Curiosity captures Jeannie, Tony and Roger bring her back.

programme.title: Angel's Child
programme.desc: While working on a robbery case, Kelly calls for police assistance when she observes the thieves escaping. A shootout occurs and one of the thieves, Joe Willow, escapes after killing a cop. Sgt. Cates takes his anger and frustration home where he batters his son, Greg. When Kelly realizes that Cates beats his son, she confronts the Sgt. and presses for child abuse charges. Joe Willow's underworld friends, Stone and Burke, observe the welfare court case awarding Kelly temporary custody of Greg while Cates works on the murder case. The thugs kidnap Kelly and Greg and attempt to persuade Cates to drop the search for Willow. Kelly manipulates her telephone answering service to alert the Angels and Cates to her house where she is being held captive. In the ensuing shootout, Kelly and Greg escape and the Angels apprehend the thugs and Willow. Cates admits his problem and is reunited with his son.

programme.title: One Of Our Angels Is Missing
programme.desc: Bondsman Harry Silvers hires the Angels to locate accused jewel thief Ray Devlin, who has fled, jumping bail. Using a cover as a wealthy divorcee, Kris is to lure Devlin from an Arizona resort back to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Catch A Falling Angel
programme.desc: Tennessean Seth Jeffers follows his girlfriend, Bess Murdock, to Los Angeles and discovers she is acting in porno movies. But when Seth disappears, the Angels are called to investigate. Kelly discovers a showbill with Bess' picture and the producer's name, Joe Willis. Kris approaches Willis and the Angels find and question Bess, who knows nothing about Seth's disappearance. Willis orders the Angels killed and they barely escape death in an auto accident. Kris steals a copy of Willis' movie and upon recognizing the locale, she has police comb the area for Jeffers' body. Bess overhears Willis tell his thugs how to handle police questions about Jeffers. She confronts him, but cannot escape Joe's plans to photograph her own death on film. Kris arrives in time to interrupt the shooting and following a brief shootout, the Angels arrive to apprehend the whole crew. A shaken Bess recuperates and returns home to Tennessee.

programme.title: Homes, Sweet Homes
programme.desc: When a wealthy Beverly Hills couple is robbed of valuable Egyptian art treasures, the Angels suspect the dapper real estate baron, Barry Kingsbrook. Kris infiltrates the Kingsbrook Agency as an agent and the Angels set up a phony house listing to lure Barry to Tiffany's supposed priceless collection of revolutionary period letters. Barry sets a deal with Bosley who poses as a wealthy collector willing to buy letters. Barry's assistant, Tina, tells him that Kris is a plant and while Tina shows Tiffany's house to prospective buyers (including the thieves) Barry takes Kris to his house where he attempts to drug her drink. The Angels capture the thieves and persuade Tina to tell where Kris is located. As the Angels arrive at Barry's house, they find that Kris has beaten Barry into confessing his role in previous thefts for money used to pay his enormous gambling debts.

programme.title: Dancin' Angels
programme.desc: A dance marathon with $5,000 in prize money attracts Joe and Sally Fairgate to compete, but when Sally disappears, Joe enlists the Angels' help in finding her. They investigate and question suspects, promoter P.J. Wilkes, investor Al Norman and leading dance couple, Steve and Jenny. Bosley discovers that Norman is a small time racketeer and Steve is a convicted hood from New York. The Angels approach the suspects to find motives for Sally's murder, making Wilkes and Norman very nervous. But when dance band singer, Billy, is found dead after an altercation with band leader Elton Mills, Kelly mistakenly confronts Mills, who confines her until he can kill her later. Wilkes and Norman admit moving Sally's body after Mills killed her. The Angels busy themselves searching for Kelly. She escapes from Mills and following a brief shootout, he is captured by the Angels, ending his attempt at a comeback as a dance band leader.

programme.title: Harrigan's Angel
programme.desc: When Starrett Electronics is the victim of a second large heist, Paul Starrett's insurance company insists he have additional help for Joseph Harrigan, a bumbling, disheveled private investigator covering the case. The Angels investigation develops leads and they question photo engraver Belkin materials and shipper Felber, who both have police records linked to Starrett. Kris and Harrigan figured out the heist method but Starrett has already ordered them killed. The Angels confront and arrest Starrett for robbing his own business. They then rush to Harrigan's apartment in time to capture Felber and Belkin attempting to kill Harrigan.

programme.title: An Angel's Trail
programme.desc: Jill Munroe is taken hostage when she accidentally stumbles into a gas station robbery. Convict Sam Mason and his sons, Clint and Harley, escape into the desolate desert hills keeping Jill tied in the back of their getaway van. Tiffany researches the geography of the highlands and discovers an old road overlooked by the search party. Hampered by wind and rain, Kris continues to lead the search for her sister when they find indications that the convicts are nearby. Jill befriends the retarded Harley who retaliates against his cruel father by battering Sam unconscious -- saving Jill from certain death. Jill sees that Harley receives special attention in the best institution for the mentally handicapped.

programme.title: Nips And Tucks
programme.desc: When a Congressional witness is found dead, the Angels investigate plastic surgeon Paul Redmont's association with racketeer Vern Maddox, who they learn wants plastic surgery to change his identity. Kris and Bosley pose as a couple seeking cosmetic surgery for Bosley, while Tiffany gathers information posing as a nurse. Redmont's girlfriend and former revolutionary, Barbara Brown, arranges for Maddox's surgery. But when nurse Elena discovers Maddox's true identity as the million dollar swindler of government pension funds, Barbara kills her. Barbara then forces Tiffany to replace Elena during the surgery of Maddox and she blackmails Redmont into completing the operation. The other Angels burst into the operating room where they subdue and apprehend Barbara and Maddox and inform Redmont that his very professional work almost changed their suspect's identity.

Barry sets a deal with Bosley who poses as a wealthy collector willing to buy letters. Barry's assistant, Tina, tells him that Kris is a plant and while Tina shows Tiffany's house to prospective buyers (including the thieves) Barry takes Kris to his house where he attempts to drug her drink. The Angels capture the thieves and persuade Tina to tell where Kris is located. As the Angels arrive at Barry's house, they find that Kris has beaten Barry into confessing his role in previous thefts for money used to pay his enormous gambling debts.

programme.title: Dancin' Angels
programme.desc: A dance marathon with $5,000 in prize money attracts Joe and Sally Fairgate to compete, but when Sally disappears, Joe enlists the Angels' help in finding her. They investigate and question suspects, promoter P.J. Wilkes, investor Al Norman and leading dance couple, Steve and Jenny. Bosley discovers that Norman is a small time racketeer and Steve is a convicted hood from New York. The Angels approach the suspects to find motives for Sally's murder, making Wilkes and Norman very nervous. But when dance band singer, Billy, is found dead after an altercation with band leader Elton Mills, Kelly mistakenly confronts Mills, who confines her until he can kill her later. Wilkes and Norman admit moving Sally's body after Mills killed her. The Angels busy themselves searching for Kelly. She escapes from Mills and following a brief shootout, he is captured by the Angels, ending his attempt at a comeback as a dance band leader.

programme.title: Harrigan's Angel
programme.desc: When Starrett Electronics is the victim of a second large heist, Paul Starrett's insurance company insists he have additional help for Joseph Harrigan, a bumbling, disheveled private investigator covering the case. The Angels investigation develops leads and they question photo engraver Belkin materials and shipper Felber, who both have police records linked to Starrett. Kris and Harrigan figured out the heist method but Starrett has already ordered them killed. The Angels confront and arrest Starrett for robbing his own business. They then rush to Harrigan's apartment in time to capture Felber and Belkin attempting to kill Harrigan.

programme.title: An Angel's Trail
programme.desc: Jill Munroe is taken hostage when she accidentally stumbles into a gas station robbery. Convict Sam Mason and his sons, Clint and Harley, escape into the desolate desert hills keeping Jill tied in the back of their getaway van. Tiffany researches the geography of the highlands and discovers an old road overlooked by the search party. Hampered by wind and rain, Kris continues to lead the search for her sister when they find indications that the convicts are nearby. Jill befriends the retarded Harley who retaliates against his cruel father by battering Sam unconscious -- saving Jill from certain death. Jill sees that Harley receives special attention in the best institution for the mentally handicapped.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) And Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Neuvottelija
programme.desc: Poliisille työskentelevä taitava neuvottelija, jota syytetään korruptiosta ja murhasta, yrittää epätoivoisesti todistaa syyttömyytensä ottamalla panttivankeja hallituksen toimistotiloissa saadakseen tarpeeksi aikaa totuuden selvittämiseen.

programme.title: Hehkuva kaupunki
programme.desc: On kulunut 200 vuotta siitä; kun viimeiset ihmiset saivat turvapaikan maanalaisesta Emberin kaupungista; mutta nyt suuri genenaattori on menossa rikki.

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat 3
programme.desc: Lomailevat pikkuoravat ja tyttötrio muuttavat luksusristeilijän omaksi leikkikentäkseen kunnes he haaksirikkoutuvat syrjäiselle saarelle.

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: Lew Wallacen eeppinen romaani lunastuksesta on tämän innostavan sovituksen sydämessä. Syytetty aatelismies (Jack Huston) selviää vuosien orjuudesta kostaakseen hänet pettäneelle ystävälleen (Toby Kebbell). Elokuvassa nähdään myös Morgan Freeman.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman. Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun.

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Aika ei anna armoa
programme.desc: Denzel Washington on pääosassa tässä mukaansatempaavassa trillerissä. Hän esittää pikkukaupungin poliisipäällikköä, joka joutuu myrskyn silmään tutkiessaan salaa tapailemansa naisen murhaa… koska kaikki todisteet viittaavat häneen!

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Power Rangers on viiden tavallisen lukiolaisen tarina. He löytävät ikivanhan avaruusaluksen ja huomaavat yhtäkkiä saaneensa yliluonnolliset voimat.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: DAREDEVIL (Ben Affleck), katujen armoton oikeudenpuolustaja, rakastuu kauniiseen taistelulajitaituri Elektraan (Jennifer Garner). Elektra perheineen joutuu häijyn palkkamurhaajan maalitauluksi ja DAREDEVILin on kohdattava tosiasia: hän saattaa menettää ainoan rakkautensa.

programme.title: A Score to Settle
programme.desc: Frank on lusinut vankilassa 22 vuotta - syyttömänä. Vapauduttuaan hän aikoo etsiä käsiinsä kaikki ne ihmiset, jotka pettivät hänet ja joiden takia hän joutui linnaan.

programme.title: Funhouse
programme.desc: Kun julkkista kutsutaan kaikkialta maailmasta kisaamaan nettirealitysarjassa, he huomaavat pian pelaavansa henkensä edestä. Pois äänestetyt joutuvat nimittäin kärsimään kammottavista seuraamuksista, jotka näytetään suorana kaikkialla maailmassa.

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja onnea
programme.desc: Tavanomaista Spencer - Hill -mättöä. Matt Kirby ja Wilbur Walsh (Hill And Spencer) ovat hieman aggressiivisia luonteita ja joutuvatkin usein vaikeuksiin, joista kuitenkin yleensä selviytyvät nyrkkiensä avulla.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Hurmaava Jon on epäonnistunut elämässään ja päättää lähteä tavoittelemaan menetettyä rakkautta. Autoekspertti Luke pakenee menneisyyttään.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa!

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Lahjakas asianajaja Casey McKay matkustaa ex-vaimonsa kotikaupunkiin puolustamaan tämän veljeä, jota syytetään piirisyyttäjän murhasta. Siellä McKay saa selville salaliiton, joka johtaa hänet avoimeen konfliktiin kaupungin korruptoituneimman rakennuttajan Gatesin kanssa.

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Keskiajan historia kirjoitetaan uudelleen, kun Jamal Walker putoaa Medieval World -teemapuiston vallihautaan ja huomaa siirtyneensä ajassa taaksepäin.

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat 3
programme.desc: Lomailevat pikkuoravat ja tyttötrio muuttavat luksusristeilijän omaksi leikkikentäkseen kunnes he haaksirikkoutuvat syrjäiselle saarelle.

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthyn tähdittämä räävittömän hillitön komedia Elokuva sijoittuu Los Angelesin laitamille, jossa nuket ja ihmiset elävät rinta rinnan.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Lahjakas uhkapeluri Michael saa viikon aikaa maksaa rikolliselle yhtiölle, muuten hänet tapetaan. Hän kerää joukon yliluonnollisia kykyjä omaavia voittaakseen suuren summan rahaa kasinolla, mutta vastustaja onkin odotettua vahvempi. Edessä on täysin uusi maailma ystävien voimien avulla.

programme.title: Kill
programme.desc: Erikoisjoukkojen sotilas Amrit saa tietää, että hänen rakastettunsa Tulika on kihlattu toiselle vasten tahtoaan. Hän lähtee junalla New Delhiin estämään järjestetyn avioliiton, mutta aseistettu rosvojoukko alkaa terrorisoida matkustajia.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Luc Bessonin toimintaelokuvan pääosassa upea Zoe Saldana (Avatar) pukeutuu koston mustaan raivatessaan tieltään vanhempiensa tappajat.COLOMBIANA on toiminnantäyteinen tarina nuoresta tytöstä, joka joutuu raakuuksien ja koston maailmaan.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Simon Westin (The Expendables 2) ohjaama ja Nicholas Cagen tähdittämä räjäyttävä toimintatrilleri.

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja tuplaten
programme.desc: Kaksoisolentojen välittämiseen erikoistunut yritys saa tilauksen kahdelta äärimmäisen vaikutusvaltaiselta liikemieheltä sijaistensa etsimiseksi. Hätiin löytyvät saksofonisti Greg ja surffaaja Eliot.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Luxurious hotels, thrilling water parks, inexpensive food and almost 300 days of bright sunny weather make Bulgaria’s biggest seaside resort, Sunny Beach popular for budget beach getaways. She goes on to visit the Castra Rubra winery, where she finds out about the history of Viticulture in Bulgaria and the process of wine making.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: A modern European oil city built on the back of a rich maritime heritage, Aberdeen is the energetic kingpin of northeast Scotland. programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to Rovaniemi, where she visits a husky farm and finds out about about breeding and raising huskies.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. programme.title: Food Fact Fun

Along the way, she finds out the secrets to the quintessential Bhutanese peace and contentment.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. Radhika Bangia finds this to be true when she visits Punakha, the former capital of Bhutan, where she marvels at the architecture of Punakha Dzong and gets to know the story behind the two rivers, Mo Chhu and Po Chhu. She also explores the sacred temples and Mebar Tsho lake of Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, and gets to know the local legends.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Otters and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: Tracking the exotic pet trade of otters across the globe, is a story of gangsters and guns, mammals, and middlemen. Japanese otter cafés and social media influencers are driving increased demand for pet otters all over the world, with devastating consequences. Ripped from the wild or irresponsibly bred, orphaned by poachers and confined in unnatural environments, these otters live a life of extreme misery. programme.title: Paseka: The Easter Elephant
programme.desc: On Easter morning, a baby elephant is mysteriously abandoned by her herd in the wilds of Botswana's Okavango Delta. We follow her first year in this spectacular African wilderness, learning daily what it means to be an elephant. What is instinctive? What is she taught by the elephants? programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
